title: Viva Glint: custom confidentiality statements for surveys
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's notice and documentation support optional administrator configuration, unchanged default messaging and the Viva Glint subscription requirement. Minor corrections should extend the control path to the toggle and acknowledge that several checklist controls have no table row.

claims.claim: Viva Glint administrators can replace Microsoft's default confidentiality statement with custom messaging.
claims.quote: Admins can choose to turn off the default statement and instead define confidentiality messaging tailored to their specific program settings
